research.facts:
Pete Crow-Armstrong — 40-40 Watch
**Sources:** si.com, mlb.com, espn.com, chicago.suntimes.com, clutchpoints.com
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- PCA hit his 40th HR on Sept. 6, 2026 vs. Miami Marlins (game-tying hit in top of 5th, 403 feet to right field)
- Cubs fell to the Marlins in that game despite PCA's 40th
- 40-40 club (all-time): Jose Canseco, Barry Bonds, Alex Rodriguez, Alfonso Soriano, Ronald Acuña Jr., Shohei Ohtani — 6 members; PCA would be 7th
- PCA has 33 SBs as of Sept. 7 pipeline; needs 7 more in approximately 18 remaining games
- First Cub to hit 40 HR since Derrek Lee in 2005
- Youngest Cub to reach 40 HR: 24 years, 165 days old (passing Ernie Banks at 24 years, 214 days in 1955)
- 4th player age 24 or younger with 40 HR + 30+ SB in same season (joining Acuña, A-Rod, Canseco)
- NL MVP frontrunner; odds approximately -1100
- Cubs record: 81-63, WC1
**Verified Facts (MEDIUM confidence):**
- PCA's exact SB count as of Sept. 8: carried forward from Sept. 7 pipeline at 33; may have added since
